# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Parch Linux is rolling release. Security fixes are provided for current packages and repositories.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Do not open public issues for security vulnerabilities.

Report privately by email:

security@parchlinux.com

Include a clear description, impact, reproduction details, and any proposed mitigation.

You will receive acknowledgment as soon as possible, followed by triage and coordinated disclosure guidance.
